note_tweet.text:
Peter Yang 实测 Claude Duet：我还是更喜欢 Grok Bot

Anthropic 刚放出个人 agent Claude Duet 的研究预览，Peter Yang 拿到了抢先体验，这期把它从头到尾用了一遍。他做 Behind the Craft，日历排满播客录制和赞助通话，newsletter 的客服也是他自己带着 AI agent 在做，算是很典型的重度用户。

他说 Duet 是他用过最主动的个人 agent。原因很简单，它默认带一个 Check-in 定时任务，从早上 9 点到晚上 10 点每三小时跑一次。他觉得它是在翻邮箱和日历，找能替他做的活。他也直说一天五次有点多。

视频大半在演示 artifact。晨间简报、每日待办、邮件分拣、YouTube 频道分析报告、赞助收入看板，还有给孩子学 AI 的探索俱乐部。为了让它替自己回邮件，他先跑了 learn-how-i-write，Duet 读了他 33 封邮件、89 条 Slack 消息、47 条私信和 11 份文档，写出一份他的写作风格指南。

短板他也讲了。让 Duet 叫 Uber 没办成，卡在要人来过的验证上，可 App 里看不到也碰不到它的浏览器。他本地的个人 skill 好像也加不进来。

最后他把 Duet 和 Grok Bot、Muse、ChatGPT Dots 摆在一起比。他说 Grok Bot 仍是他目前最爱的 agent，免费的 X 集成很适合做市场调研，缺点是邮件还不太好用。说到 Claude，他说现在 Claude 是他主力的 harness 和模型，Duet 是 Anthropic 个人 agent 很棒的开局，他很期待后面的改进。

note_tweet.text:
Three days in, one of my bots refused another bot's word that I'd approved something: "I need to hear it from you here."

That's when I noticed how much my Grok Bot use has changed. Day one was "connect this". Today it's mostly "go".

Grok Bot plans, Claude Code does the work. My CX bot reviews a backlog, commits a handoff file to my shared repo and messages Claude Remote, which runs Claude Code on my Mac. The results come back to the CX bot. 4 rounds today. Claude Remote wanted my yes in its own chat, not passed along by another bot. So I say yes twice, and I'm fine with that.

What else changed:
• Tiers instead of item by item. My CX bot sorts work into "go", "check and go" and "needs a plan", so I approve a batch in one word.
• Schedules over chat. This was the biggest win as my chief of staff sends an attention list every hour, 9am to 9pm: what needs me across Slack, email and calendar. I tried it for one afternoon and asked for it again the next day. It skips the hour when nothing is new.
• Bots setting up bots. One bot spun up my data analyst with a rule I'd told it that morning already built in.
• One shared changelog. Grok Bot and Claude Code both write to it. When I asked if everything was logged, the CX bot audited itself and found 2 gaps.

I've stopped asking my bots for things. Mostly I approve what they've already lined up.

BREAKING: OpenAI lost. Muse won.

Meta has the best AI agent - and no, I am not sponsored by Meta to tell you it's the best.

Enterpret launched Feedback Bench 1.1 (https://t.co/ZVgU2I7ypt), which ranks 9 personal AI agents using public posts from Reddit, X, YouTube, the App Store and the Play Store.

1/  The variables

☑ Popularity: how many people talk about the agent on socials. Hype is a good proxy for usefulness.

☑ Customer love: how users rate it compared with the other agents. 0.5 is the peer average.

☑ The heaviest-weighted area is “Getting tasks done” (~25%). Users care most about whether the agent is capable of doing things. I feel the same.

2/ The ranking

🥇 Muse (Meta)
🥈 Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
🥉 Grok Bot (xAI)

4. Hark (Hark Labs)
5. OpenClaw (OpenClaw Foundation)
6. Instinct (Spear Street)
7. Gemini Spark (Google)
8. ChatGPT Dots (OpenAI)
9. Poke (The Interaction Co.)

3/ Why using an AI agent vs. Claude/ChatGPT?

Technically, ChatGPT or Claude are "agents". People are getting ahead of themselves with this word. But Muse/Hermes/Grok Bot go an extra mile.

↳ They are using their own computer (not yours) to get things done. We call it "computer use" and it's useful to get things done on their own.

↳ You don't need to select their "intelligence". No more models or efforts to choose from.

↳ It's made for personal use cases. Do your taxes, book flights, shop online, fill out a form, etc.

PS: Claude just announced "Duet", their own personal agent. I will try to get early access; who wants to be in?

note_tweet.text:
GROK BOT HOW TO USE
Sources: official Grok Bot docs + Cursor help + your Grok Bot bookmark folder (1040 posts)
Updated: 2026-10-22

WHAT NEW TODAY
- Official Elon (Oct 20, via SawyerMerritt): Grok Bot is the fastest-growing product he has ever seen; usage per user keeps rising week over week; Enterprise Grok Bot in wide deployment in a few weeks; Grok Bot will use most of SI compute
- Official Elon (Oct 18): Grok Bot can call restaurants by phone and book you a table
- Testers (BrianRoemmele, Oct 18): free restaurant-booking Bot. Tell it the place, party size and time; it finds the number, asks your flexibility, name and callback number, reads it back and waits for your OK before dialing, then reports what the restaurant said and offers a calendar entry
- Official bot (Oct 16): quality, polish and speed improvements; chat cards have a cleaner new design
- SpaceXAI notes (blankspeaker, Oct 20): Version 0.72.0 — agent status as an elevated card, share an agent with your team / copy into a team workspace, live status on the linked pull request, pin items in your library
- Testers (mattyp, Oct 20): What's new video — new chat cards, speed, draft edits, email aliases, X DMs, tag the bot, connectors, voice calls, notifications, invites and Android Assistant, access lists, unread, routines, sign-in
- Testers (ScottyBeamIO, Oct 16): Grok Bot can now read X Chat messages and message requests; he uses it to sort the inbox, review requests, keep partnership talks moving and reply
- Testers (EricLDaugh, Oct 15): after Amazon blocked Grok Bot from placing orders, Elon said "Maybe we should start a competitor to Amazon."
- Testers (tibor_tee, Oct 15): Ship Code at Scale event — Grok Bot coordinates the work, Cursor Cloud Agents write and verify the code
- Testers (XFreeze, Oct 19): handles almost any laptop task, including paid tasks like shopping and booking flights and hotels
- Testers (BrianRoemmele, Oct 14): essay "The Grok Bot Age Is Here And The Software Age Just Ended"
- Official Elon (Oct 14): "Grok Bot is awesome"

WHAT IT IS
- A Bot is a named, persistent teammate, not a one-off chat
- You message it like a coworker and it finishes work in real apps
- All of your Bots share one cloud computer (browser, files, terminal)
- Each Bot has its own screen on that shared computer
- Work keeps going when your laptop or the app is closed
- It only comes back when it needs approval or a human step
- Do not confuse Grok Bot with Digital Optimus (real-time video human emulation)
- Testers (joehansen): do not confuse Grok Bot with an X Chat Agent (an X account you add to a group chat). Grok Bot is the machine that does the work
- Official Elon: Your Bot will identify issues to resolve, notify you when they are fixed, and continue on with your project

ACCESS AND INSTALL
- Testers (MIPAGUY / SpaceXAI): Team Bots public beta for Teams and Enterprise — shared teammates with skills/plugins/credentials via Slack or Grok Bot
- Official Elon (Sep 23–25): Grok Bot growing ~100% a month
- Official / Testers: SpaceXAI support rebuilt on Grok Bot — 175% ticket surge, ~200 hires avoided, ~$0.20–$0.30/ticket
- Official bot (Aug 26): All SuperGrok and Cursor Pro subscribers now have access
- Testers (mattyp): Grok Bot is free to try; every Grok & Cursor plan includes Grok Bot
- Cursor CEO Michael Truell: everyone with a standard Grok or Cursor subscription
- Official bot + Elon: weekly / free usage limits reset for all Grok Bot users
- Sign in with your Cursor account (that account owns plan and usage)
- Official desktop is macOS and Windows (Apple silicon or Intel; Windows x64 or Arm64)
- Testers (mattyp): Linux is now supported (official docs may lag)
- iPhone: iOS 18+, App Store app "Grok Bot"
- Official (bot, Sep 2): Grok Bot is now available on Android
- Testers (mark_k): install from Play Store; full Grok Bot experience on Android
- Official docs may still lag on Android; Testers (mattyp, Sep 4): Grok Bot is now available for iPad
- SuperGrok Heavy users can choose Get access with SuperGrok Heavy, then Link Grok Account
- Linking SuperGrok Heavy can unlock free Cursor Ultra (one Grok account to one Cursor account)
- Testers (unicodef1wn, Sep 10): plans don’t stack — linking SuperGrok to a Cursor plan adds zero usage; upgrade within Cursor or turn on on-demand if you need more
- Legacy Privacy Mode blocks Grok Bot; switch to a supported Cursor data setting first
- Grok Bot checks for updates automatically; Check for Updates is in Settings → Beta
- Official Elon (Sep 4): Grok Bot Enterprise is now available
- Official Grok (grok, Sep 23): Grok Bot and Connectors now work in your Tesla
- Testers (WatcherGuru / cb_doge, Sep 22): 400,000+ weekly users one month after launch (418k as of Sep 14, +24% week)
- Official (jediahkatz, Sep 22): bots reply quicker to texts; another ~6% more usage on average
- Testers (GrokBotRadar, Sep 22): Grok 4.7 usable from Grok Bot — set Default Model → Edit → Grok 4.7, effort xhigh; hand hard jobs to Cursor Cloud Agent (unnamed inherits default)
- Official Elon (Sep 17): Grok Bot now has a voice
- Official (jediahkatz, Sep 17): ~10% more effective usage — less subagent overuse, less bot-to-bot chatter, smarter low-effort batch routing; group chats are token-heavy

SIGN IN
[] Desktop: Get started, then Sign In with Cursor in the browser
[] iOS: Login with Cursor, finish in the browser, return to the app
[] Official: Cmd-D turns on voice dictation
[] Official: it is easier to use the remote computer from your phone
[] Use the same Cursor account that should own usage
[] First-run tour asks which tools you use; that only shapes teammate suggestions
[] Computer setup runs in the background, then Meet a future teammate opens

CREATE A BOT
[] Testers (Michael_Fenech_, Sep 28): turn on training mode as a standing memory rule so Bot teaches memory/routines/skills/connectors as you go until you say “training mode off”
[] New in the sidebar, or Cmd/Ctrl+N
[] In New chat, choose Create new agent
[] Edit Profile: name, title, description, avatar
[] Give a short name, one primary job, and how it should work
[] Description = standing rules (never send without approval)
[] Chat messages = this-task instructions (draft follow-ups for these 12 accounts)
[] Focused Bots beat one catch-all General Helper
[] Testers (XFreeze): do not design a Bot from scratch; ask a Bot to create a capable one for you (it already has your context)
[] Pin important Bots; hide unused ones (hiding does not pause routines)
[] Testers (B_doong2daddy, Sep 15): prefer boring specialist Bots (Inbox/Research/Ops/Code Review/Scheduling) over one super-Bot; Bot built MCP on local NAS and connected a Roborock
[] Duplicate a Bot to reuse a role for a new scope (copy does not include memory or history)
[] Delete only if you are sure; files and logins on the shared computer stay
[] Account limit: 50 Bots and group chats combined
[] Name language can steer reply language (bookmark testers reported this)
[] Official Elon / Grok Bot team (Sep 17): Grok Bot now has a voice — talk to bot
[] Official (bot, Sep 18): Grok Bot can now send you voice notes
[] Testers (GrokBotDev): Official Marketplace launched (about 69 bots listed; community has catalogued 420+ searchable from a Bot)
HOW TO WRITE A TASK
[] Outcome: what should be finished
[] Testers (unicodef1wn): Grok Bot meters agent steps and tokens, not messages — vague tasks wander and burn the week; scope with Task / Work in / Context / Done means / first N items then stop
[] Sources: which apps, sites, files, or chats matter
[] Constraints: what it must not do, or must ask first
[] Deliverable: what it should return
[] Review point: when it should stop for you
[] Safe first task: attach a file and ask for a cited summary; do not change the file
[] Next task: one real tool, read-only, with a sign-in handoff if needed
[] After a good result, name the lasting format preference in chat
[] Then save it as a skill or routine
[] Official bot examples: email cleanup, Starlink-likely flights, build a site then buy the domain and deploy, meeting notes, sales prospecting, refunds, podcast audio digest
[] Testers: one clear job, explicit allowed sources, no-guessing rule, approval gate before any real action
[] Testers: 5 calibrations - confidence threshold, checkpoint long tasks, show negative examples, gate destructive actions separately, test edge cases first
[] Testers (AlexFinn): anything you are about to do on your computer, ask Grok Bot first
[] Testers (GrokBotRadar, Sep 17): Research/compare/decide in Grok; open apps / change / send / finish in Grok Bot — Grok thinks, Grok Bot acts

AGENT COMPUTER AND LOGINS
[] Open Agent Computer from the conversation to watch the desktop
[] Grok Bot team (poteto, Sep 22): desktop 53 perf fixes — reconnect 60s→0.7s; wake laptop 23s→1s; Computer view switch 868ms→27ms; long code-block chats 954ms→228ms; Media tab 137MB→0.7MB; lower idle memory
[] Official Elon (Sep 14): Grok Bot now lets you route through your local machine (Bot Computer egress via your IP / local machine)
[] Take over for password, passkey, 2FA, CAPTCHA, payment, or human-only pages
[] Complete only the blocked step, then return control
[] Never paste passwords or one-time codes into chat
[] Official (bot, Sep 8): fill out forms and logins for your Bot without ever leaving the chat, with support for any password manager
[] Testers (XFreeze): when a site needs your account, Bot pauses; you auth with 1Password / Apple Passwords / any manager; Bot continues — no pasting credentials into chat
[] Testers (XFreeze, Sep 16): Disk Saver — when Bot Computer storage runs low, audits space and suggests safe clears (caches/temp/duplicates); nothing deleted without your approval
[] Grok Bot team (poteto, Sep 9): account switching is finally here
[] Official (bot, Sep 9): Share a file directly with Grok Bot on mobile
[] Use a secure secret request when the app offers one
[] Browser sessions persist and are shared across all your Bots
[] Prefer a connector/plugin when one exists; use the browser when it does not
[] Coinbase (coinbase, Sep 9): Coinbase for Agents on Grok — connect Coinbase on its site; tell Grok to trade, analyze, automate; no MCP setup
[] Official (bot, Sep 11): Grok Bot can now search and act across Microsoft Teams for you
[] Keep durable files in /workspace with clear project folders
[] Settings → Beta: Update Agent Computer (preserve state), Recover, or Reset (can lose recent work)
[] The cloud computer is not your Mac or Windows machine
[] Local-computer execution is separate: Settings → General → Agent → Execution on Local Computer
[] Default local policy is Ask every time; use Never allowed unless you need local files
[] Testers (XFreeze): take over that same cloud computer from your phone without being at the laptop

PLUGINS AND CONNECTORS
- Testers (ScottyBeamIO, Oct 16): Grok Bot can read X Chat messages and message requests (sort inbox, review requests, reply)
[] Official bot (Sep 26): Finance / Plaid connector — bank, card, investments
[] Testers (GrokBotRadar / benln): QoL connectors — Docs/Sheets/Slides native, 1Password vault, inline forms, email/Slack drafts
[] Settings → Plugins, then Add, then authenticate in the browser
[] Grok Bot team (poteto): tinkabot helps build MCP/skills plugins and submit them for approval so all users can use them
[] Type @ to attach a connector; type / to reference a saved skill
[] Official Grok / Tesla (Sep 22–23): Connectors work from Grok in your Tesla — manage inbox, calendar, files/chat/tasks hands-free; SuperGrok Heavy first
[] Installed connectors are account-wide, not isolated to one Bot
[] Official: you can connect multiple accounts to the same plugin
[] Official bot (Aug 26): SuperGrok and Cursor Pro now included; weekly limits reset. Testers quoting SpaceXAI: also Plus/Heavy/Pro+/Ultra/Teams
[] Testers (mvanhorn): give a Bot its own inbox, not your Gmail (one mistake should not flag your domain); Twilio number so a Bot can make calls
[] Official bot: improved X support - connect your X profile; a developer account is auto-created with included credits
[] Testers (blankspeaker): Plugins, add X, authenticate; $100 in X API credits good for a year (new and existing devs)
[] Follow the Connect card when a Bot asks for a plugin
[] Bookmark testers: Grok Bot can now read your X bookmarks
[] Grok Bot team (poteto) + testers (XFreeze): Microsoft connectors live - Outlook, Outlook Calendar, OneDrive (search/send email, drafts, schedules, meetings, browse/upload files)
SKILLS AND ROUTINES
[] Skill = reusable how-to (steps, rules, output, approval boundary)
[] Routine = when to run that work (schedule or event)
[] Do the task once, make it reliable, save a skill, then automate
[] Teach a task: open computer view, choose Teach a task, demo up to 10 minutes, review the draft skill
[] Teaching records the screen, not microphone audio; do not expose secrets while teaching
[] If Teach a task is missing, ask the Bot to write a skill from the completed work
[] Create a routine on the Bot that should own the job
[] Confirm owner, schedule, time zone, input, result, approval, and missing-data behavior
[] Event triggers (Slack, GitHub) are separate from plugins and need their own connection
[] Keep event matchers narrow; avoid every new message
[] Testers (unicodef1wn): never trigger on every new message (docs warn broad listeners eat usage); pick one channel and one keyword; audit forgotten dailies
[] Testers (unicodef1wn): add to every routine — if the source is unavailable, report the failure instead of using old data; test run before you schedule
[] Test run does real work; use safe inputs
[] Testers quoting docs: Test can send real emails to real clients; Stop is a brake, not a rewind
[] View conversation details → Routines to pause, edit, inspect, or delete
[] A Bot can own 50 routines; last 20 run records are kept
[] Deleting a routine has no undo
[] Long absence can pause unattended routines until you confirm

MULTI BOT TEAMS
[] Official / Testers: Team Bots public beta — shared AI teammates for Teams/Enterprise
[] Start with one Bot that owns an end-to-end outcome
[] Add a specialist only when the role is stable
[] Use a group chat when the handoff itself should be visible
[] Bots can message each other and pass ownership
[] Do not treat separate Bots as a security boundary (they share the computer)
[] Keep sending, buying, deleting, publishing, and production changes behind approval
[] Testers: put Bots in one group chat, appoint a Chief of Staff, and stop being the router
[] Testers (liam_fallen, Sep 13): weekly Chief of Staff 1:1s with each Bot — what did you do / went wrong / need / should change; fixes what it can and brings the rest to you
[] Testers: add a RED TEAM Bot whose job is to disprove the thesis; no single source closes a claim
[] Testers (mvanhorn): Bot Advisor whose only job is building and tightening other Bots; files are the memory bus between Bots
IOS
[] Same Bots, chats, routines, plugins, and cloud computer as desktop
[] Testers (mattyp): Grok Bot supports 21+ localized languages on mobile
[] Send text, dictate, attach photos/files, mention Bots, reply in threads
[] Take over the computer for login/2FA from the phone
[] You can pause or resume a routine on iOS
[] Editing schedule, run history, test, delete, and teach-by-demo still need desktop
[] Enable notifications for results, questions, and approvals
[] Testers: phone notification shows the proposed action; approve or deny

APPROVALS AND SAFETY
[] Put the stop line in the request: draft, do not send; ask after showing current vs proposed
[] Official (bot, Sep 9): ask your Bot to draft messages inline for you to approve before sending
[] Desktop: Allow once, Deny, or Always allow a matching rule
[] iPhone: Approve once or Deny
[] Auto Review: Settings → General → Auto-review
[] Require Approval beats Always Allow when both match
[] Write narrow rules, not allow everything in the browser
[] Do not approve an action you cannot identify
[] Connect only the tools the workflow needs
[] Start read-only; keep spend, send, publish, delete, and production behind approval
[] Sign out and revoke connectors when access should end
[] Deleting a Bot does not wipe shared files or browser sessions
[] Bookmark testers: one person burned a 7-day quota in about 8 hours
[] Testers (unicodef1wn): check Weekly usage in the account menu before any big run; one long job can eat an entire trial credit
[] Official (jediahkatz, Sep 17): another ~10% more effective usage from less subagent overuse / less bot-to-bot chatter / smarter low-effort batch routing; beware group chats — bigger chats cost more tokens
[] Official (jediahkatz, Sep 22): bots reply quicker to texts; another ~6% more usage on average
[] Testers: gate destructive actions (delete, overwrite, irreversible send) as their own confirmation, not lumped with routine tool use
[] Official bot Link shopping: keep purchases behind approval even though the Bot can complete them on your behalf

FIRST BOTS WORTH CREATING
- Restaurant booker (Elon + BrianRoemmele, Oct 18): it phones the restaurant, confirms details with you first, then reports back
[] Inbox manager for email and Slack triage
[] Calendar and reservation Bot
[] Research and daily brief Bot
[] Coding Bot that can launch Cursor cloud agents
[] Testers (Dmytroo_eth, Sep 15): don’t use Grok Bot like search — show up as one engineer running many cloud agents
[] Chief-of-staff hub that routes work to specialists
[] Personal errands Bot (tickets, food, travel, forms)
[] Content Bot that drafts in your voice for approval
[] Chief-of-staff that researches you, organizes the other Bots, and can turn the digest into a morning podcast
[] Testers (techdevnotes): default Bots circulating - Night Shift (overnight digest), Inbox Triage, Chief of Staff, Negotiator, Prototyper, Researcher, Shopper, Apartment Scout, Lookout, Competitor Watcher
[] Official bot + Link: Shopper Bot can now complete online purchases once link is connected (keep approval on)
[] Testers (SPCXTSLA, Sep 15): shopper Bot template — Amazon/Costco/Instacart/Walmart; research + best price; return-window and price-drop routines; Link/card checkout on Bot Computer
[] Official Elon (Sep 15): interest in a Bot that finds the biggest constraint in your business and pings you weekly on what to focus on
[] Testers (niccruzpatane): Accounting Bot (invoices, spending, bills); Personal Bot (flights, rides, Airbnb, Google Calendar, Amazon orders/returns); Home Bot (lights, robots, speakers, thermostats)

EVENTS
- Official bot (Sep 15): LIVE Grok Bot Galaxy Day 1 — mattyp / poteto / roshan_s build a company from scratch in 3 days; Eng/PM/Founders sessions

ELON PUT CLAUDE'S BRAIN INSIDE GROK BOT. NOW ANTHROPIC USED THE SAME BRAIN TO BUILD ITS KILLER.

Elon announced it himself. His bot would pick the best model for each task, "including Claude Opus 5.5." 

Claude Duet runs on that exact Opus 5.5.

Duet lives on its own computer in the cloud. You close your laptop, turn off your phone, go to sleep, and it keeps going:
→ Every few hours it checks your Gmail, Slack, Stripe, QuickBooks, anything you hook up from 6,000+ connectors.
→ It decides what matters and hands you one brief in the morning.
→ It builds the work for you, from forecasts to dashboards to full web apps.

And Anthropic put a lock on your money that even you can't override. Beg it, approve it, Duet still won't trade a single stock or move a dollar between your accounts.

Grok Bot's leaked prompt tells it "Your default is to act, not to ask." Anthropic says Duet "checks with you before it acts on your behalf."

So who gets your inbox tonight, Elon's bot or the company that builds its brain?
